headline: Pre-workout supplement recalled nationwide for containing illegal ingredient

sources.excerpt: Leader Formulas, LLC has recalled three flavors of its Rapture pre-workout supplements nationwide after FDA testing detected 1,3-dimethylamylamine (DMAA), the agency announced Wednesday. The synthetic stimulant can raise blood pressure and cause cardiovascular problems, including shortness of breath, chest tightness, and heart attacks. Product name: Rapture Pre Workout. Size: 450 g. Lot number: 260327-4. Flavor: Rainbow Twist. UPC: 710154236506. Flavor: Electric Lemonade. UPC: 710143 236513. Flavor: Berry Mojito. UPC: 710154236544. The recalled products were sold nationwide through various retailers and the Leader Formulas website from Jan. 29, 2025, to May 25, 2026. If you have the recalled pre-workout, stop using it immediately and return it for a full refund. Seek medical attention if you experience any health problems that may be related to the recalled products. So far, Leader Formulas has not received any reports of adverse events.

A pre-workout dietary supplement is being recalled nationwide after it was found to contain an ingredient the U.S. Food and Drug Administration declared illegal more than a decade ago. According to the recall alert listed by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, Leader Formulas of Texas is voluntarily recalling one lot of RAPTURE Pre-workout, a dietary supplement powder, because it was found to contain 1,3-Dimethylamylamine (DMAA). According to the FDA, DMAA-containing products marketed as dietary supplements are illegal and their marketing violates the law. The recall warns that using DMAA can result in elevated blood pressure and could lead to cardiovascular problems, including heart attack, shortness of breath and tightening of the chest. “The issue was discovered in the product during testing by the FDA. Leader Formulas, LLC. is notifying its distributors and customers by mail and is arranging for return of all recalled products,” states the recall alert. “Consumers who have purchased the RAPTURE Preworkout products which are being recalled should stop using the products and return to the place of purchase for a full refund.” The recalled product was distributed nationwide to retail stores and sold online through the company website between Jan. 29, 2025, and May 25, 2026. Description: 450g round plastic container with red and black lettering and a rhinoceros print seal on top of the container. Lot number: 260327-4. So far, Leader Formulas has said the company has not received any reports of health concerns related to the recall. According to the Department of Defense, DMAA has been illegal in dietary supplements since 2013, but many dietary supplement products that contain (or at least claim to contain) DMAA are still available for sale. Consumers who believe they have been harmed by using a DMAA-containing product are advised by the FDA to contact their healthcare practitioner. Consumers can also report incidents directly to the FDA through the Safety Reporting Portal.
